scripts.bridge:dev: cd apps/game-bridge && uv run python -m zml_game_bridge.main
scripts.bridge:ocr: cd apps/game-bridge && set ZML_OCR_ENABLED=1&& uv run python -m zml_game_bridge.main
scripts.bridge:mock: cd apps/game-bridge && set ZML_MOCK_INPUTS=1&& uv run python -m zml_game_bridge.main
scripts.bridge:finder-debug: cd apps/game-bridge && set ZML_OCR_ENABLED=1&& set ZML_FINDER_DEBUG=1&& uv run python -m zml_game_bridge.main
scripts.bridge:lint: cd apps/game-bridge && uv run ruff check .
scripts.bridge:format: cd apps/game-bridge && uv run ruff format .
scripts.bridge:test: cd apps/game-bridge && uv run pytest --basetemp .pytest-tmp -o cache_dir=.pytest-cache-local
scripts.bridge:verify: npm run bridge:lint && npm run bridge:typecheck && npm run bridge:test
